crewNotes.text: IMPORTANT: these are PASSENGER allowances - Indonesian regulations give operating CREW reduced allowances, so confirm the crew figures with Bea Cukai. Compiled from the cited Bea Cukai guidance, pending final review.

rules.text: Passengers aged 21 or over may bring in a maximum of 1 litre of alcoholic beverage.
Cash or equivalent of IDR 100,000,000 or more (or the foreign-currency equivalent) must be declared on arrival or departure.

declarationRequirements.text: Personal goods up to USD 500 FOB per person per arrival are exempt; above that, 10% import duty plus taxes apply.

rules.text: Passenger allowance is up to 200 cigarettes, or 25 cigars, or 100g of loose tobacco (with separate limits for e-cigarettes/e-liquid).

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: Directorate General of Customs and Excise (Bea Cukai)
